### PyYAML package initialization sequence

Source: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/main/_autodocs/overview.md

The code executed upon importing the yaml package, which sets up the version, LibYAML availability, and exports core components.

```python
from .error import *
from .tokens import *
from .events import *
from .nodes import *

from .loader import *
from .dumper import *

__version__ = '7.0.0.dev0'
try:
    from .cyaml import *
    __with_libyaml__ = True
except ImportError:
    __with_libyaml__ = False
```

### Windows wheel CI matrix with Python 3.13 amd64, arm64, and win32 builds

Source: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yaml

The CI configuration builds Windows wheels (amd64, arm64, win32) for Python 3.13 via cibuildwheel. The win32 entry has a comment noting uncertainty about win32 support beyond 3.13, but cp313-win32 is still included.

```yaml
          - spec: cp313-win_amd64
            arch: x64
            omit: ${{ env.skip_ci_redundant_jobs }}

          - spec: cp313-win_arm64
            arch: arm64
            runs-on: windows-11-arm
            omit: ${{ env.skip_ci_redundant_jobs }}

          - spec: cp313-win32
            arch: win32
            omit: ${{ env.skip_ci_redundant_jobs }}

          # no more win32 after 3.13?
```

### Layout

Source: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/main/_autodocs/overview.md

- `lib/yaml/` — the pure-Python package (`yaml` import name).
- `yaml/_yaml.pyx` — Cython source for the optional LibYAML extension (`yaml._yaml` import name), exposing `CParser`, `CEmitter`, `get_version()`, `get_version_string()`.
- `lib/_yaml/__init__.py` — deprecated compatibility shim that re-exports `yaml._yaml` and warns.
- `setup.py` — build with `--with-libyaml` / `--without-libyaml` switches.
- `packaging/_pyyaml_pep517.py` — PEP 517 build backend bridging setuptools `build_meta`.

--------------------------------

### Build-time configuration

Source: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/main/_autodocs/configuration.md

## Build-time configuration

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `setup.py --with-libyaml` / `--without-libyaml` | CLI flag | auto (build if LibYAML is found) | Force build/skip of the `yaml._yaml` extension. Implemented via `Distribution.global_options`/`negative_opt` (`setup.py:120–152`). |
| `pyyaml_build_config` (PEP 517 `config_settings` JSON) | str (JSON) in `--config-settings` | absent | Merged into build_ext options by the custom backend `packaging/_pyyaml_pep517.py`; unknown keys are ignored (`setup.py:193–218`). Note the backend treats array-valued settings by string concatenation. |
| `LIBYAML-REF` (Makefile, default `0.2.5`) | git ref | `0.2.5` | Pinned LibYAML revision used by `make test-libyaml` / `make test` local builds. |
| `PYTHON-VERSION` (Makefile) | Python version string | system python | e.g. `make test PYTHON-VERSION=3.13.5` selects the interpreter for the test venv. |

--------------------------------

### Environment variables

Source: https://github.com/yaml/pyyaml/blob/main/_autodocs/configuration.md

## Environment variables

| Variable | Scope | Values | Effect | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|--------|--------|
| `PYYAML_FORCE_LIBYAML` | build/install | `'1'` / `'0'` (or unset) | Force include/exclude of the LibYAML extension during `setup.py` build. `ext_status` coerces the value with `int()`. Unset (or `None`-from-attr) = "build if available". | `setup.py:159` |
| `PYYAML_FORCE_CYTHON` | build/install | `'1'` | Re-run Cython to regenerate `yaml/_yaml.c` from `yaml/_yaml.pyx` (also triggered by the `sdist` command). Any other value uses the shipped C file. | `setup.py:80` |
| `LIBYAML-REF` | `make test-libyaml` | git ref string, default `0.2.5` | LibYAML checkout pinned by the Makefile for the local test build. | `Makefile:33–34` |

Note on `PYYAML_FORCE_LIBYAML=0`: `ext_status` returns `False`, so `build_ext.run` skips compilation and falls back to the pure-Python `yaml` package (`lib/yaml/*.py`), with `yaml.__with_libyaml__ == False`.
